source_refs.note: Roman Urdu introduction to simple harmonic motion (PDF 18-19).

blocks.text: Yeh chapter simple harmonic motion (S.H.M.) par baat karta hai, jhoolne wali (oscillatory) harkat ki aik khaas qism jis mein bahaal karne wali quwwat (restoring force) cheez ko hamesha us ki darmiyani jagah (mean position) ki taraf wapas kheenchti hai. Yeh S.H.M. ke peeche riyazi aur physics ko dekhta hai: is ki khasiyatein, is ki equations aur haqeeqi duniya mein is ke istemal.

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat
blocks.text: Bohat se qudrati mazahir dauri (periodic) harkat dikhate hain: zameen ki Sooraj ke gird harkat, chaand ki zameen ke gird, pani ki lehrein, awaz ki lehrein, tuning fork, jhoolne wali kursi aur bohat se doosre.

blocks.prompt: Qudrat mein dauri harkat ki teen misalein dein.
blocks.explanation: In mein se koi teen: zameen ka Sooraj ke gird ghoomna, chaand ka zameen ke gird, pani ki lehrein, awaz ki lehrein, thartharata tuning fork.

items: S.H.M.: aisi oscillation jis mein restoring force jism ko darmiyani jagah ki taraf wapas kheenchti.
